title: RevealBundle
description: Shipping container, not an entity and never rendered as an element: everything about one trend that may exist in the page only after the viewer's intuition record. One file per trend, data/reveal/<trendId>.js, loaded by dynamic import() at the gut-reading step and not before (A-6). Holds the three Readings and the Interrogation. Cross-document rules that JSON Schema cannot express are checked by the M1 referential-integrity test: every Reading's and the Interrogation's trendId equals the bundle's trendId, and each Reading's id equals the readingId the Trend holds for that lens.
